key.name: open-in-browser
key.summary: Open online videos in the web browser
key.description: Open videos from online services in the web browser instead of the embedded player.

key.name: youtube-api-key
key.description: Optional YouTube Data API v3 key used for searching when no Google account is connected.

key.name: peertube-instances
key.description: Comma separated addresses of the PeerTube instances to browse.
